## Weighted average power plots by beta and k

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Weighted average power plots by beta and k
## Two weighting ways:
##   1) cluster_abund_sum_template
##   2) cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance
##
## Visualization revisions:
##   - smooth each line
##   - keep raw dots
##   - constrain smooth curves to [0, 1]
##   - once power hits 1, keep smooth curve at 1 afterward
##   - box around each subfigure
##   - publication-ready legend labels
##   - no title / subtitle
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## Keep k <= 8
results <- results %>%
  filter(k <= 8)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define colors ONLY for methods you want to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_colors <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "#556B2F",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "#66CD00",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "#76EE00",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "#84B12B",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "#79CDCD",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "#4A708B",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "#6E93E8",
  "aitchison"                 = "#D8902F",
  "bray"                      = "#FF8C69",
  "euclidean"                 = "#8B0000",
  "jaccard"                   = "#EE8262"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Publication-ready method labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "Unweighted UniFrac",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "Weighted UniFrac",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Weighting options to plot
## ---------------------------------------------------------
weight_options <- c(
  "abund_sum",
  "abund_sum_x_mean_abund"
)

weight_labels <- c(
  "abund_sum" = "Weighted by cluster abundance sum",
  "abund_sum_x_mean_abund" = "Weighted by abundance sum × mean relative abundance"
)

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)

## -------------------- output folder --------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## -------------------- create long-format result --------------------
select_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

if (has_signal_mode) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "signal_mode")
}

long_res_base <- results %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    beta > 0,
    method %in% names(method_colors)
  )

## =========================================================
## Smoothing helper
##
## Rules:
##   1) smooth within each line
##   2) clamp to [0, 1]
##   3) if raw or smoothed power reaches 1,
##      all later smooth values are set to 1
## =========================================================

smooth_one_curve <- function(dat, y_col = "weighted_power",
                             n_grid = 200, span = 0.75,
                             hit1_tol = 1e-8) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(beta), !is.na(.data[[y_col]])) %>%
    arrange(beta)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(beta = numeric(0), power_smooth = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  x <- dat$beta
  y <- dat[[y_col]]
  
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  
  if (length(ux) == 1) {
    out <- data.frame(
      beta = ux,
      power_smooth = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    
    out$power_smooth <- pmin(pmax(out$power_smooth, 0), 1)
    
    if (any(y >= 1 - hit1_tol, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      out$power_smooth <- 1
    }
    
    return(out)
  }
  
  grid_x <- seq(
    min(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(x, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = n_grid
  )
  
  pred_y <- NULL
  
  ## Try LOESS when enough beta points are available
  if (length(ux) >= 4 && length(unique(y)) >= 2) {
    
    fit <- try(
      loess(
        formula = as.formula(paste0(y_col, " ~ beta")),
        data = dat,
        span = span,
        degree = 2,
        family = "gaussian",
        control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
      pred_try <- try(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(beta = grid_x)),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(pred_try, "try-error") && !all(is.na(pred_try))) {
        pred_y <- pred_try
      }
    }
  }
  
  ## Fallback: linear interpolation
  if (is.null(pred_y)) {
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xout = grid_x,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## Fill occasional NA predictions
  if (any(is.na(pred_y))) {
    good <- !is.na(pred_y)
    
    if (sum(good) >= 2) {
      pred_y <- approx(
        x = grid_x[good],
        y = pred_y[good],
        xout = grid_x,
        rule = 2
      )$y
    } else {
      pred_y[is.na(pred_y)] <- mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  ## Clamp to [0, 1]
  pred_y <- pmin(pmax(pred_y, 0), 1)
  
  ## Once raw power reaches 1, keep all later smoothed values at 1
  raw_hit_beta <- suppressWarnings(min(x[y >= 1 - hit1_tol], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  ## Also check whether the smoothed curve itself reaches 1
  smooth_hit_beta <- suppressWarnings(min(grid_x[pred_y >= 1 - hit1_tol], na.rm = TRUE))
  
  hit_beta <- min(raw_hit_beta, smooth_hit_beta, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (is.finite(hit_beta)) {
    pred_y[grid_x >= hit_beta] <- 1
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    beta = grid_x,
    power_smooth = pred_y
  )
  
  return(out)
}

## =========================================================
## Main function for one weighting option
## =========================================================

make_weighted_power_plot <- function(weight_option) {
  
  cat("\n============================================================\n")
  cat("Processing weighting option:", weight_option, "\n")
  cat("============================================================\n\n")
  
  long_res <- long_res_base %>%
    mutate(
      weight = case_when(
        weight_option == "abund_sum" ~
          cluster_abund_sum_template,
        weight_option == "abund_sum_x_mean_abund" ~
          cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
  
  if (any(is.na(long_res$weight))) {
    stop("Some weights are NA for weight_option = ", weight_option)
  }
  
  if (any(long_res$weight < 0, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    stop("Some weights are negative for weight_option = ", weight_option)
  }
  
  ## -------------------- weighted average power --------------------
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    
    weighted_power <- long_res %>%
      filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject), !is.na(weight), weight > 0) %>%
      group_by(k, signal_mode, beta, method) %>%
      summarise(
        weighted_power = weighted.mean(reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
        total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(k, signal_mode, beta, method)
    
  } else {
    
    weighted_power <- long_res %>%
      filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject), !is.na(weight), weight > 0) %>%
      group_by(k, beta, method) %>%
      summarise(
        weighted_power = weighted.mean(reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
        n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
        total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(k, beta, method)
  }
  
  weighted_power <- weighted_power %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
      weighted_power = pmin(pmax(weighted_power, 0), 1)
    )
  
  ## -------------------- save unsmoothed table --------------------
  write.csv(
    weighted_power,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("Weighted power table saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, ".csv")), "\n\n")
  
  print(as.data.frame(weighted_power), row.names = FALSE)
  
  ## -------------------- smooth --------------------
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    
    smooth_power <- weighted_power %>%
      group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
      group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(
        dat = .x,
        y_col = "weighted_power",
        n_grid = 200,
        span = 0.75
      )) %>%
      ungroup()
    
  } else {
    
    smooth_power <- weighted_power %>%
      group_by(k, method) %>%
      group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(
        dat = .x,
        y_col = "weighted_power",
        n_grid = 200,
        span = 0.75
      )) %>%
      ungroup()
  }
  
  smooth_power <- smooth_power %>%
    mutate(
      method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
      power_smooth = pmin(pmax(power_smooth, 0), 1)
    )
  
  ## -------------------- save smoothed table --------------------
  write.csv(
    smooth_power,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, "_smoothed.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
  
  cat("\nSmoothed weighted power table saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_", weight_option, "_smoothed.csv")), "\n\n")
  
  present_methods <- names(method_colors)[
    names(method_colors) %in% as.character(unique(weighted_power$method))
  ]
  
  ## -------------------- plot --------------------
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_line(
      data = smooth_power,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = power_smooth,
        color = method,
        group = method
      ),
      linewidth = 0.95,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = weighted_power,
      aes(
        x = beta,
        y = weighted_power,
        color = method,
        group = method
      ),
      size = 0.80,
      alpha = 0.85
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = method_colors[present_methods],
      breaks = present_methods,
      labels = method_labels[present_methods],
      drop = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
    ) +
    labs(
      x = expression(beta),
      y = "Weighted average power",
      color = NULL
    )
  
  if (has_signal_mode) {
    p <- p +
      facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k, labeller = label_both)
  } else {
    p <- p +
      facet_wrap(~ k, labeller = label_both)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    theme_bw(base_size = 13, base_family = "serif") +
    theme(
      ## box around each subfigure
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
      
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
      
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.key = element_blank(),
      legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.42, "cm"),
      
      panel.spacing = unit(0.9, "lines")
    ) +
    guides(
      color = guide_legend(
        ncol = 1,
        byrow = TRUE,
        override.aes = list(
          linewidth = 1.2,
          size = 1.8,
          alpha = 1
        )
      )
    )
  
  print(p)
  
  ## -------------------- save plot --------------------
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.png")),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.pdf")),
    plot = p,
    width = 14,
    height = 8
  )
  
  cat("\nSmoothed plot saved to:\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.png")), "\n")
  cat(file.path(outdir, paste0("weighted_power_lineplot_", weight_option, "_smooth.pdf")), "\n")
  
  invisible(list(
    weighted_power = weighted_power,
    smooth_power = smooth_power,
    plot = p
  ))
}

## =========================================================
## Run both weighting figures
## =========================================================

plot_results <- list()

for (w in weight_options) {
  plot_results[[w]] <- make_weighted_power_plot(w)
}

cat("\nAll weighted power plots saved to:\n")
cat(outdir, "\n")
```
## Smoothed power plot using the largest cluster only
```{r}
## =========================================================
## Smoothed power plot using the largest cluster only
##
## Updates:
## 1) each facet has a border box
## 2) smoothed values are constrained to [0, 1]
## 3) once the smoothed curve hits 1, it stays at 1 afterwards
## 4) raw points are kept
## 5) no title / subtitle
## 6) publication-ready legend labels
##
## Output folder:
##   weighted_power_output
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define colors ONLY for methods you want to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included
##
## Order here = legend order
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_colors <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "#507D39",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "#8CB26C",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "#AAC576",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "#D7E9BC",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "#5A97D0",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "#79B0D7",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "#2F74B8",
  "aitchison"                 = "#FFE082",
  "bray"                      = "#FFCA28",
  "euclidean"                 = "#FFB300",
  "jaccard"                   = "#FF8F00"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Publication-ready method labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "Unweighted UniFrac",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "Weighted UniFrac",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)
has_cluster_ordered <- "cluster_ordered" %in% names(results)

## -------------------- output folder --------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## -------------------- define situation columns --------------------
situation_cols <- c("k", "beta")
if (has_signal_mode) {
  situation_cols <- c("k", "signal_mode", "beta")
}

## -------------------- choose max-n-OTU cluster under each situation --------------------
cluster_select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  cluster_select_cols <- c(cluster_select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

cluster_choice <- results %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_select_cols)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  {
    if (has_cluster_ordered) {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        cluster_ordered,
        signal_cluster
      )
    } else {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        signal_cluster
      )
    }
  } %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols))) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Selected largest cluster under each situation:\n")
print(as.data.frame(cluster_choice), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  cluster_choice,
  file = file.path(outdir, "selected_max_n_otu_cluster_by_situation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

## -------------------- keep only selected clusters --------------------
selected_results <- results %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  inner_join(
    cluster_choice %>%
      select(all_of(situation_cols), signal_cluster),
    by = c(situation_cols, "signal_cluster")
  )

## -------------------- long-format p-values --------------------
select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

long_res <- selected_results %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% names(method_colors))

## -------------------- compute power for selected cluster only --------------------
if (has_signal_mode) {
  
  max_n_otu_power <- long_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject)) %>%
    group_by(
      k, signal_mode, beta,
      signal_cluster, cluster_n_otus_template,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      power = mean(reject, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(k, signal_mode, beta, method)
  
} else {
  
  max_n_otu_power <- long_res %>%
    filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject)) %>%
    group_by(
      k, beta,
      signal_cluster, cluster_n_otus_template,
      method
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      power = mean(reject, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(k, beta, method)
}

max_n_otu_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors))
  )

## -------------------- save unsmoothed power table --------------------
write.csv(
  max_n_otu_power,
  file = file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nPower table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power.csv"), "\n\n")

print(as.data.frame(max_n_otu_power), row.names = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## Smoothing helper
##
## Rules:
## 1) smooth within each line
## 2) clamp to [0, 1]
## 3) once the smoothed curve hits 1, keep all later values at 1
## =========================================================

smooth_one_curve <- function(dat, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75, hit1_tol = 1e-8) {
  
  dat <- dat %>%
    filter(!is.na(beta), !is.na(power)) %>%
    arrange(beta)
  
  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(beta = numeric(0), power_smooth = numeric(0)))
  }
  
  x <- dat$beta
  y <- dat$power
  
  ux <- sort(unique(x))
  
  ## only one unique beta
  if (length(ux) == 1) {
    out <- data.frame(
      beta = ux,
      power_smooth = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
    out$power_smooth <- pmin(pmax(out$power_smooth, 0), 1)
    
    hit_idx <- which(out$power_smooth >= 1 - hit1_tol)
    if (length(hit_idx) > 0) {
      out$power_smooth[min(hit_idx):nrow(out)] <- 1
    }
    return(out)
  }
  
  grid_x <- seq(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max(x, na.rm = TRUE), length.out = n_grid)
  
  pred_y <- NULL
  
  ## try loess first if enough support
  if (length(ux) >= 4 && length(unique(y)) >= 2) {
    fit <- try(
      loess(
        power ~ beta,
        data = dat,
        span = span,
        degree = 2,
        family = "gaussian",
        control = loess.control(surface = "direct")
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )
    
    if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
      pred_try <- try(
        predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(beta = grid_x)),
        silent = TRUE
      )
      
      if (!inherits(pred_try, "try-error") && !all(is.na(pred_try))) {
        pred_y <- pred_try
      }
    }
  }
  
  ## fallback: linear interpolation
  if (is.null(pred_y)) {
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      xout = grid_x,
      ties = mean,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## fill NA if needed
  if (any(is.na(pred_y))) {
    good <- !is.na(pred_y)
    pred_y <- approx(
      x = grid_x[good],
      y = pred_y[good],
      xout = grid_x,
      rule = 2
    )$y
  }
  
  ## clamp to [0, 1]
  pred_y <- pmin(pmax(pred_y, 0), 1)
  
  ## once hit 1, remain at 1
  hit_idx <- which(pred_y >= 1 - hit1_tol)
  if (length(hit_idx) > 0) {
    pred_y[min(hit_idx):length(pred_y)] <- 1
  }
  
  out <- data.frame(
    beta = grid_x,
    power_smooth = pred_y
  )
  
  return(out)
}

## -------------------- apply smoothing --------------------
if (has_signal_mode) {
  
  smooth_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
    group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
    group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(.x, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
} else {
  
  smooth_power <- max_n_otu_power %>%
    group_by(k, method) %>%
    group_modify(~ smooth_one_curve(.x, n_grid = 200, span = 0.75)) %>%
    ungroup()
}

smooth_power <- smooth_power %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = names(method_colors)),
    power_smooth = pmin(pmax(power_smooth, 0), 1)
  )

## -------------------- save smoothed table --------------------
write.csv(
  smooth_power,
  file = file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power_smoothed.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nSmoothed power table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "max_n_otu_cluster_power_smoothed.csv"), "\n\n")

## -------------------- methods actually present --------------------
present_methods <- names(method_colors)[names(method_colors) %in% as.character(unique(max_n_otu_power$method))]

## =========================================================
## Plot
## =========================================================

p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(

  ) +

    x = expression(beta),
    y = "Power",

  )

if (has_signal_mode) {
  p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- p_max_n_otu_power_smooth +
    facet_grid(signal_mode ~ k, labeller = label_both)
} else {

p_max_n_otu_power_smooth <- p_max_n_otu_power_smooth +
```

## Type I error table under each situation

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Type I error table under each situation
##
## Three ways:
## 1) abund_sum:
##      weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template
##
## 2) abund_sum_x_mean_abund:
##      weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template *
##                  cluster_mean_relative_abundance
##
## 3) max_n_otu_cluster:
##      select the cluster with maximum cluster_n_otus_template
##      under each null situation
##
## Output:
##   1) long-format table
##   2) wide-format table with methods as columns
##   3) one CSV per way
##
## Saved under:
##   weighted_power_output
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Methods to include
## If a method is not listed here, it will be excluded.
## AHC_euclidean is intentionally not included.
##
## Order here = table order
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_order <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted",
  "GLaD_1_weighted",
  "unifrac_unweighted",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq",
  "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison",
  "bray",
  "euclidean",
  "jaccard"
)

## Publication-ready method names
method_labels <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "Unweighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "Weighted GLaD (rho = 1)",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "Unweighted UniFrac",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "Weighted UniFrac",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Checks
## ---------------------------------------------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k",
  "signal_cluster",
  "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

has_signal_mode <- "signal_mode" %in% names(results)
has_cluster_ordered <- "cluster_ordered" %in% names(results)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Output folder
## ---------------------------------------------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", outdir, "\n\n")

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Define situation columns
## For type I error, beta is fixed at 0, so situation does not include beta.
## ---------------------------------------------------------
situation_cols <- "k"

if (has_signal_mode) {
  situation_cols <- c("k", "signal_mode")
}

## =========================================================
## 1. Long null data: beta == 0
## =========================================================

select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "beta",
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_abund_sum_template",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

null_long <- results %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    false_reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(method %in% method_order)

if (nrow(null_long) == 0) {
  stop("No beta == 0 rows found after filtering. Cannot compute type I error.")
}

## =========================================================
## 2. Way 1: weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template
## =========================================================

type1_abund_sum <- null_long %>%
  mutate(
    way = "abund_sum",
    weight = cluster_abund_sum_template
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject),
    !is.na(weight),
    weight > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols)), method, way) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = weighted.mean(false_reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 3. Way 2: weighted by cluster_abund_sum_template * mean abundance
## =========================================================

type1_abund_sum_x_mean_abund <- null_long %>%
  mutate(
    way = "abund_sum_x_mean_abund",
    weight = cluster_abund_sum_template * cluster_mean_relative_abundance
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject),
    !is.na(weight),
    weight > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols)), method, way) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = weighted.mean(false_reject, w = weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    total_weight = sum(weight[!is.na(pval)], na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 4. Way 3: select max cluster_n_otus_template under each null situation
## =========================================================

cluster_select_cols <- c(
  situation_cols,
  "signal_cluster",
  "cluster_n_otus_template"
)

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  cluster_select_cols <- c(cluster_select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

max_cluster_choice_type1 <- results %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  select(all_of(cluster_select_cols)) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  {
    if (has_cluster_ordered) {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        cluster_ordered,
        signal_cluster
      )
    } else {
      arrange(
        .,
        across(all_of(situation_cols)),
        desc(cluster_n_otus_template),
        signal_cluster
      )
    }
  } %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(situation_cols))) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Selected max-n-OTU cluster under each null situation:\n")
print(as.data.frame(max_cluster_choice_type1), row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(
  max_cluster_choice_type1,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_selected_max_n_otu_cluster_by_situation.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

null_long_max_cluster <- null_long %>%
  inner_join(
    max_cluster_choice_type1 %>%
      select(all_of(situation_cols), signal_cluster),
    by = c(situation_cols, "signal_cluster")
  )

type1_max_n_otu_cluster <- null_long_max_cluster %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(pval),
    !is.na(false_reject)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    way = "max_n_otu_cluster"
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    across(all_of(situation_cols)),
    signal_cluster,
    cluster_n_otus_template,
    method,
    way
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = mean(false_reject, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## =========================================================
## 5. Combine all three ways: long table
## =========================================================

type1_table_long <- bind_rows(
  type1_abund_sum,
  type1_abund_sum_x_mean_abund,
  type1_max_n_otu_cluster
) %>%
  mutate(
    method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
    method_label = unname(method_labels[as.character(method)]),
    way = factor(
      way,
      levels = c(
        "abund_sum",
        "abund_sum_x_mean_abund",
        "max_n_otu_cluster"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(way, across(all_of(situation_cols)), method)

## round only for display/table export
type1_table_long_round <- type1_table_long %>%
  mutate(
    type1_error = round(type1_error, 4),
    total_weight = ifelse(
      "total_weight" %in% names(.),
      round(total_weight, 4),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

write.csv(
  type1_table_long_round,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_long.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("\nLong-format type I error table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_long.csv"), "\n\n")

## =========================================================
## 6. Wide table: methods as columns
## =========================================================

type1_table_wide <- type1_table_long %>%
  select(
    all_of(situation_cols),
    way,
    method_label,
    type1_error
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    type1_error = round(type1_error, 4)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = method_label,
    values_from = type1_error
  ) %>%
  arrange(way, across(all_of(situation_cols)))

write.csv(
  type1_table_wide,
  file = file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_wide.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Wide-format type I error table saved to:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_wide.csv"), "\n\n")

cat("============================================================\n")
cat("TYPE I ERROR TABLE UNDER EACH SITUATION\n")
cat("Wide format: one row = one situation and one way\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

print(as.data.frame(type1_table_wide), row.names = FALSE)

## =========================================================
## 7. Save one wide table per way
## =========================================================

for (ww in unique(as.character(type1_table_wide$way))) {
  
  tmp <- type1_table_wide %>%
    filter(way == ww) %>%
    select(-way)
  
  write.csv(
    tmp,
    file = file.path(outdir, paste0("type1_error_each_situation_", ww, ".csv")),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

cat("\nIndividual wide tables saved:\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_abund_sum.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_abund_sum_x_mean_abund.csv"), "\n")
cat(file.path(outdir, "type1_error_each_situation_max_n_otu_cluster.csv"), "\n")
```

## Others

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Published-ready power heatmaps under each situation
##
## Revised version:
##   - one heatmap for each (k, signal_mode)
##   - beta panels are wrapped into multiple rows
##   - avoids ggsave dimension > 50 inches
##   - color scale: highest power -> lowest power
##       #D93F49, #E28187, #EBBFC2, #D5E1E3, #AFC9CF, #8FB4BE
##
## Heatmap:
##   x-axis = method
##   y-axis = signal cluster
##   fill   = empirical power
##
## Output:
##   weighted_power_output/power_heatmaps
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(grid)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## Optional: keep only k <= 8
results <- results %>%
  filter(k <= 8)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Methods to include and display order
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_order <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted",
  "GLaD_1_weighted",
  "unifrac_unweighted",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq",
  "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison",
  "bray",
  "euclidean",
  "jaccard"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Publication-ready method labels
## ---------------------------------------------------------
method_labels <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted"       = "Unweighted GLaD\n(rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted"         = "Weighted GLaD\n(rho = 0.5)",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted"         = "Unweighted GLaD\n(rho = 1)",
  "GLaD_1_weighted"           = "Weighted GLaD\n(rho = 1)",
  "unifrac_unweighted"        = "Unweighted\nUniFrac",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq" = "Weighted\nUniFrac",
  "GUniFrac"                  = "GUniFrac",
  "aitchison"                 = "Aitchison",
  "bray"                      = "Bray-Curtis",
  "euclidean"                 = "Euclidean",
  "jaccard"                   = "Jaccard"
)

## ---------------------------------------------------------
## Heatmap fill palette
## User gave highest -> lowest:
##   D93F49, E28187, EBBFC2, D5E1E3, AFC9CF, 8FB4BE
##
## ggplot needs low -> high, so reverse it here.
## ---------------------------------------------------------
heatmap_fill <- c(
  "#8FB4BE",
  "#AFC9CF",
  "#D5E1E3",
  "#EBBFC2",
  "#E28187",
  "#D93F49"
)

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) {
  stop("Object 'results' is not found in your environment.")
}

if (!is.data.frame(results)) {
  stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")
}

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

needed_cols <- c("k", "signal_cluster", "beta", "signal_mode")
missing_cols <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required columns:\n",
    paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)

if (length(p_cols) == 0) {
  stop("No p-value columns beginning with 'p_' were found in results.")
}

has_cluster_ordered <- "cluster_ordered" %in% names(results)

## -------------------- output folder --------------------
outdir <- file.path(getwd(), "weighted_power_output")
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

heatmap_outdir <- file.path(outdir, "power_heatmaps")
dir.create(heatmap_outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("Output folder:\n", heatmap_outdir, "\n\n")

## =========================================================
## Step 1: reshape p-values to long format
## =========================================================

select_cols <- c("k", "signal_cluster", "signal_mode", "beta")

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  select_cols <- c(select_cols, "cluster_ordered")
}

long_res <- results %>%
  select(all_of(select_cols), all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    beta > 0,
    method %in% method_order
  )

## =========================================================
## Step 2: compute empirical power
## =========================================================

group_vars <- c("k", "signal_cluster", "signal_mode", "beta", "method")

if (has_cluster_ordered) {
  group_vars <- c(
    "k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered",
    "signal_mode", "beta", "method"
  )
}

power_heatmap <- long_res %>%
  filter(!is.na(pval), !is.na(reject)) %>%
  group_by(across(all_of(group_vars))) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(reject, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    power = pmin(pmax(power, 0), 1)
  )

write.csv(
  power_heatmap,
  file = file.path(heatmap_outdir, "power_heatmap_data.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat("Saved heatmap data table:\n")
cat(file.path(heatmap_outdir, "power_heatmap_data.csv"), "\n\n")

## =========================================================
## Step 3: make one heatmap for each (k, signal_mode)
## =========================================================

k_values <- sort(unique(power_heatmap$k))

for (kk in k_values) {
  
  signal_modes_k <- sort(unique(power_heatmap$signal_mode[power_heatmap$k == kk]))
  
  for (smode in signal_modes_k) {
    
    cat("Making heatmap for k =", kk, "| signal_mode =", smode, "\n")
    
    dat_ks <- power_heatmap %>%
      filter(k == kk, signal_mode == smode)
    
    ## -------------------- cluster ordering --------------------
    if (has_cluster_ordered) {
      cluster_key <- dat_ks %>%
        distinct(signal_cluster, cluster_ordered) %>%
        arrange(cluster_ordered, signal_cluster) %>%
        mutate(cluster_label = paste0("C", cluster_ordered))
    } else {
      cluster_key <- dat_ks %>%
        distinct(signal_cluster) %>%
        arrange(signal_cluster) %>%
        mutate(cluster_label = paste0("C", signal_cluster))
    }
    
    dat_ks <- dat_ks %>%
      left_join(cluster_key, by = "signal_cluster")
    
    cluster_levels <- cluster_key$cluster_label
    
    beta_values <- sort(unique(dat_ks$beta))
    
    dat_ks <- dat_ks %>%
      mutate(
        method = factor(method, levels = method_order),
        method_label = factor(
          method_labels[as.character(method)],
          levels = method_labels[method_order]
        ),
        cluster_label = factor(cluster_label, levels = rev(cluster_levels)),
        beta_label = factor(
          paste0("beta = ", beta),
          levels = paste0("beta = ", beta_values)
        ),
        power_label = sprintf("%.2f", power),
        text_color = ifelse(power >= 0.62, "white", "black")
      )
    
    ## -------------------- decide facet layout --------------------
n_beta <- length(beta_values)
n_cluster <- length(cluster_levels)
n_method <- length(method_order)

## Use up to 4 beta panels per row
facet_ncol <- min(4, n_beta)

## Increase figure width so x-axis method labels do not overlap
## Each beta panel gets enough horizontal space for all methods
single_panel_width <- max(8.5, 0.75 * n_method)

plot_width <- min(
  48,
  max(18, facet_ncol * single_panel_width)
)

plot_height <- max(
  6,
  min(
    24,
    ceiling(n_beta / facet_ncol) * (0.45 * n_cluster + 1.6)
  )
)
    
    ## -------------------- plot --------------------
    p_heat <- ggplot(
      dat_ks,
      aes(x = method_label, y = cluster_label, fill = power)
    ) +
      geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.65) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = power_label, color = text_color),
        size = 3.0,
        family = "serif",
        show.legend = FALSE
      ) +
      scale_color_identity() +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colours = heatmap_fill,
        limits = c(0, 1),
        breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
        labels = sprintf("%.1f", seq(0, 1, by = 0.2)),
        name = "Power"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(
        ~ beta_label,
        ncol = facet_ncol
      ) +
      labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = "Signal cluster"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 12, base_family = "serif") +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.6),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
        
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, color = "black"),
        
        axis.text.x = element_text(
  angle = 45,
  hjust = 1,
  vjust = 1,
  size = 8.5,
  color = "black",
  lineheight = 0.85
),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
        
        legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.7, "cm"),
        
        panel.spacing = unit(0.7, "lines"),
        plot.margin = margin(8, 10, 8, 8)
      )
    
    print(p_heat)
    
    ## -------------------- save plot --------------------
    safe_smode <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_\\-]+", "_", smode)
    
    png_file <- file.path(
      heatmap_outdir,
      paste0("power_heatmap_k", kk, "_", safe_smode, ".png")
    )
    
    pdf_file <- file.path(
      heatmap_outdir,
      paste0("power_heatmap_k", kk, "_", safe_smode, ".pdf")
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = png_file,
      plot = p_heat,
      width = plot_width,
      height = plot_height,
      dpi = 300
    )
    
    ggsave(
      filename = pdf_file,
      plot = p_heat,
      width = plot_width,
      height = plot_height
    )
    
    cat("Saved:\n")
    cat(png_file, "\n")
    cat(pdf_file, "\n\n")
  }
}

cat("All published-ready power heatmaps have been saved to:\n")
cat(heatmap_outdir, "\n")
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Analyze which method is best under each situation
## Assumes the combined data frame is already loaded as: results
##
## "Situation" = (k, signal_mode, beta)
##
## This code prints:
## 1) type I error summary by method
## 2) power summary by method and situation
## 3) a combined ranking table
## 4) winner tables:
##    - best by raw power
##    - best among methods controlling type I error
##    - best by a balanced score
##
## No files are saved
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## exact type I control threshold used for "controlled" winner
type1_tol_mean <- 0.00   # change to 0.01 if you want a looser rule
type1_tol_max  <- 0.00   # change to 0.01 if you want a looser rule

## -------------------- checks --------------------
if (!exists("results")) stop("Object 'results' is not found.")
if (!is.data.frame(results)) stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

needed_cols <- c("k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered", "signal_mode", "beta")
miss_needed <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(miss_needed) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(miss_needed, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) stop("No p-value columns found in results.")

## -------------------- reshape p-values --------------------
long_res <- results %>%
  select(k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta, all_of(p_cols)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = sub("^p_", "", method))

## -------------------- per-cluster power/type I --------------------
## beta > 0 => power
power_cluster <- long_res %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, method) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(pval < alpha_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## beta = 0 => type I error
type1_cluster <- long_res %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, method) %>%
  summarise(
    type1_error = mean(pval < alpha_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -------------------- method-level summaries --------------------
## summarize power across signal clusters, keeping beta separate
power_method_summary <- power_cluster %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clusters = n_distinct(signal_cluster),
    mean_power = mean(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_power = median(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_power = min(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_power = max(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_power = sd(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## summarize type I error across clusters
type1_method_summary <- type1_cluster %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
  summarise(
    n_clusters = n_distinct(signal_cluster),
    mean_type1 = mean(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_type1 = median(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_type1 = min(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_type1 = max(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_type1 = sd(type1_error, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_clusters_over_alpha = mean(type1_error > alpha_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -------------------- combine power + type I --------------------
analysis_table <- power_method_summary %>%
  left_join(type1_method_summary, by = c("k", "signal_mode", "method")) %>%
  mutate(
    controls_type1_mean = mean_type1 <= alpha_level + type1_tol_mean,
    controls_type1_max  = max_type1  <= alpha_level + type1_tol_max,
    controls_type1_both = controls_type1_mean & controls_type1_max,
    
    ## raw deviation from nominal alpha
    abs_mean_type1_dev = abs(mean_type1 - alpha_level),
    abs_max_type1_dev  = abs(max_type1 - alpha_level),
    
    ## balanced score: higher is better, penalize type I deviation
    ## change penalty if you want stronger/weaker emphasis on type I control
    balanced_score = mean_power - abs(mean_type1 - alpha_level),
    
    ## strict controlled score: only methods passing control are eligible
    controlled_power_score = ifelse(controls_type1_both, mean_power, NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  arrange(k, signal_mode, beta, desc(controls_type1_both), desc(mean_power), abs_mean_type1_dev)

## -------------------- helper: collapse ties --------------------
collapse_top <- function(x, score) {
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  top <- max(score, na.rm = TRUE)
  paste(x[score == top], collapse = "; ")
}

## -------------------- winners by scenario --------------------
best_power_table <- analysis_table %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    best_raw_power = collapse_top(method, mean_power),
    best_raw_power_value = max(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

best_balanced_table <- analysis_table %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    best_balanced = collapse_top(method, balanced_score),
    best_balanced_value = max(balanced_score, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

best_controlled_table <- analysis_table %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    best_controlled = {
      tmp <- method[controls_type1_both]
      scr <- mean_power[controls_type1_both]
      if (length(tmp) == 0) NA_character_ else collapse_top(tmp, scr)
    },
    best_controlled_power = {
      tmp <- mean_power[controls_type1_both]
      if (length(tmp) == 0) NA_real_ else max(tmp, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    n_controlled_methods = sum(controls_type1_both, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

winner_table <- best_power_table %>%
  left_join(best_balanced_table, by = c("k", "signal_mode", "beta")) %>%
  left_join(best_controlled_table, by = c("k", "signal_mode", "beta")) %>%
  arrange(k, signal_mode, beta)

## -------------------- method win counts --------------------
## raw power wins
raw_power_wins <- analysis_table %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  filter(mean_power == max(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(method, name = "n_raw_power_wins") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_raw_power_wins), method)

## controlled wins
controlled_wins <- analysis_table %>%
  filter(controls_type1_both) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  filter(mean_power == max(mean_power, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(method, name = "n_controlled_wins") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_controlled_wins), method)

## balanced wins
balanced_wins <- analysis_table %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  filter(balanced_score == max(balanced_score, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(method, name = "n_balanced_wins") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_balanced_wins), method)

win_summary <- full_join(raw_power_wins, controlled_wins, by = "method") %>%
  full_join(balanced_wins, by = "method") %>%
  mutate(
    n_raw_power_wins = ifelse(is.na(n_raw_power_wins), 0L, n_raw_power_wins),
    n_controlled_wins = ifelse(is.na(n_controlled_wins), 0L, n_controlled_wins),
    n_balanced_wins = ifelse(is.na(n_balanced_wins), 0L, n_balanced_wins)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_controlled_wins), desc(n_balanced_wins), desc(n_raw_power_wins), method)

## -------------------- print tables --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("TYPE I ERROR SUMMARY BY METHOD\n")
cat("mean_type1 / max_type1 are summarized across signal clusters within each (k, signal_mode)\n")
cat("A method is called 'controlled' here if:\n")
cat("  mean_type1 <= ", alpha_level + type1_tol_mean,
    " and max_type1 <= ", alpha_level + type1_tol_max, "\n", sep = "")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

type1_print <- type1_method_summary %>%
  mutate(
    mean_type1 = round(mean_type1, 4),
    median_type1 = round(median_type1, 4),
    min_type1 = round(min_type1, 4),
    max_type1 = round(max_type1, 4),
    sd_type1 = round(sd_type1, 4),
    prop_clusters_over_alpha = round(prop_clusters_over_alpha, 4)
  ) %>%
  arrange(k, signal_mode, mean_type1, method) %>%
  as.data.frame()

print(type1_print, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("POWER + TYPE I ERROR RANKING TABLE\n")
cat("Situation = (k, signal_mode, beta)\n")
cat("mean_power is summarized across signal clusters, keeping beta separate\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

analysis_print <- analysis_table %>%
  mutate(
    mean_power = round(mean_power, 4),

print(analysis_print, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("WINNER TABLE BY SITUATION\n")
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## Model "when each method can win"
## Assumes your combined data frame is already loaded as: results
##
## Goal:
## Instead of only filtering winners, this code builds interpretable models
## for "winning" and prints tables showing:
##
## 1) which method wins in each situation
## 2) one-vs-rest logistic models for each method
## 3) coefficient / odds-ratio tables
## 4) model-predicted winning situations for each method
## 5) a compact "what to say" summary table for each method
##
## No files are saved
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(rpart)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## type I error control rule
## a method is considered "controlled" in a given (k, signal_mode) if
## mean_type1 <= alpha_level and max_type1 <= alpha_level
type1_tol_mean <- 0.00
type1_tol_max  <- 0.00

## -------------------- check input --------------------
if (!exists("results")) stop("Object 'results' is not found.")
if (!is.data.frame(results)) stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered", "signal_mode", "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template", "cluster_avg_silhouette",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance", "cluster_mean_prevalence",
  "within_cop_mean"
)
miss_needed <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(miss_needed) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns:\n", paste(miss_needed, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) stop("No p-value columns found in results.")

## -------------------- long p-value table --------------------
long_res <- results %>%
  select(
    k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta,
    cluster_n_otus_template, cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance, cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean,
    all_of(p_cols)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = sub("^p_", "", method))

## -------------------- power at each exact situation --------------------
## exact situation = (k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta)
power_cluster <- long_res %>%
  filter(beta > 0) %>%
  group_by(
    k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta, method,
    cluster_n_otus_template, cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance, cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    power = mean(pval < alpha_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_nonmissing = sum(!is.na(pval)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## -------------------- type I error by (k, signal_mode, method) --------------------
type1_method <- long_res %>%
  filter(beta == 0) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_mode, method) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_type1 = mean(pval < alpha_level, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_type1 = max(tapply(pval < alpha_level,
                           INDEX = interaction(signal_cluster, drop = TRUE),
                           FUN = mean,
                           na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    controls_type1 = (mean_type1 <= alpha_level + type1_tol_mean) &
                     (max_type1  <= alpha_level + type1_tol_max)
  )

## -------------------- join type I info back to power table --------------------
model_df <- power_cluster %>%
  left_join(type1_method, by = c("k", "signal_mode", "method")) %>%
  mutate(
    controls_type1 = ifelse(is.na(controls_type1), FALSE, controls_type1),
    mean_type1 = ifelse(is.na(mean_type1), NA_real_, mean_type1),
    max_type1 = ifelse(is.na(max_type1), NA_real_, max_type1)
  )

## -------------------- define winners --------------------
## raw winner: highest power in each exact situation
model_df <- model_df %>%
  group_by(k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  mutate(
    raw_best_power = max(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    win_raw = power == raw_best_power
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

## controlled winner:
## among methods that control type I error, choose highest power;
## if no method controls, fall back to raw winner
controlled_best <- model_df %>%
  group_by(k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    any_controlled = any(controls_type1, na.rm = TRUE),
    best_controlled_power = if (any(controls_type1, na.rm = TRUE)) {
      max(power[controls_type1], na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      max(power, na.rm = TRUE)
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  )

model_df <- model_df %>%
  left_join(controlled_best,
            by = c("k", "signal_cluster", "signal_mode", "beta")) %>%
  mutate(
    win_controlled = ifelse(
      any_controlled,
      controls_type1 & (power == best_controlled_power),
      power == best_controlled_power
    )
  )

## -------------------- scenario winner tables --------------------
scenario_raw_winner <- model_df %>%
  filter(win_raw) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    raw_winner = paste(sort(unique(method)), collapse = "; "),
    raw_winner_power = max(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

scenario_controlled_winner <- model_df %>%
  filter(win_controlled) %>%
  group_by(k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  summarise(
    controlled_winner = paste(sort(unique(method)), collapse = "; "),
    controlled_winner_power = max(power, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

scenario_winner_table <- scenario_raw_winner %>%
  left_join(
    scenario_controlled_winner,
    by = c("k", "signal_cluster", "cluster_ordered", "signal_mode", "beta")
  ) %>%
  arrange(k, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("ACTUAL WINNER TABLE BY EXACT SITUATION\n")
cat("Situation = (k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta)\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(as.data.frame(scenario_winner_table), row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- one-vs-rest logistic models --------------------
## This models: in what situations does a given method win?
##
## outcome = win_controlled
## predictors = k + signal_mode + beta + cluster features
##
## Note:
## - k is treated as factor
## - signal_mode is factor
## - cluster features are numeric
## - beta:signal_mode interaction is included
##
## If a model has no variation in win_controlled (all 0 or all 1),
## it will be skipped.

method_list <- sort(unique(model_df$method))
model_list <- list()
coef_table_list <- list()
tree_rule_list <- list()

for (m in method_list) {
  dat_m <- model_df %>%
    mutate(
      win = as.integer(method == m & win_controlled),
      k = factor(k),
      signal_mode = factor(signal_mode)
    )
  
  ## keep one row per method-situation
  dat_m <- dat_m %>%
    mutate(win = as.integer(method == m & win_controlled)) %>%
    filter(method == m | TRUE)  # keep all rows, win says whether this method won
  
  ## create method-specific win indicator
  dat_m$win <- as.integer(dat_m$method == m & dat_m$win_controlled)
  
  ## fit only if both classes exist
  if (length(unique(dat_m$win)) < 2) {
    message("Skipping method ", m, " because win outcome has no variation.")
    next
  }
  
  fit_glm <- glm(
    win ~ k + signal_mode + beta +
      cluster_n_otus_template +
      cluster_avg_silhouette +
      cluster_mean_relative_abundance +
      cluster_mean_prevalence +
      within_cop_mean +
      beta:signal_mode,
    data = dat_m,
    family = binomial()
  )
  
  model_list[[m]] <- fit_glm
  
  sm <- summary(fit_glm)$coefficients
  coef_tab <- data.frame(
    method = m,
    term = rownames(sm),
    estimate = sm[, "Estimate"],
    std_error = sm[, "Std. Error"],
    z_value = sm[, "z value"],
    p_value = sm[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    odds_ratio = exp(sm[, "Estimate"]),
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  coef_table_list[[m]] <- coef_tab
  
  ## also fit a small tree for readable "rules"
  fit_tree <- rpart::rpart(
    factor(win) ~ k + signal_mode + beta +
      cluster_n_otus_template +
      cluster_avg_silhouette +
      cluster_mean_relative_abundance +
      cluster_mean_prevalence +
      within_cop_mean,
    data = dat_m,
    method = "class",
    control = rpart.control(cp = 0.01, minsplit = 20, maxdepth = 3)
  )
  
  tree_rule_list[[m]] <- capture.output(print(fit_tree))
}

coef_table <- bind_rows(coef_table_list)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("LOGISTIC MODEL COEFFICIENT TABLES\n")
cat("Interpretation:\n")
cat("- positive estimate / OR > 1 => that condition helps the method win\n")
cat("- negative estimate / OR < 1 => that condition hurts the method win\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

coef_print <- coef_table %>%
  mutate(
    estimate = round(estimate, 4),
    std_error = round(std_error, 4),
    z_value = round(z_value, 4),
    p_value = signif(p_value, 4),
    odds_ratio = round(odds_ratio, 4)
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, p_value)

print(as.data.frame(coef_print), row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- print tree rules --------------------
cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("TREE RULES FOR EACH METHOD\n")
cat("These are simple rule-based approximations of when a method wins.\n")
cat("============================================================\n")

for (m in names(tree_rule_list)) {
  cat("\n##############################\n")
  cat("METHOD:", m, "\n")
  cat("##############################\n")
  cat(paste(tree_rule_list[[m]], collapse = "\n"))
  cat("\n")
}

## -------------------- model-predicted winner on observed situations --------------------
## Use the observed situation rows (without method), and let each method model predict
## the probability that the method wins in that situation.

scenario_features <- model_df %>%
  select(
    k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta,
    cluster_n_otus_template, cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance, cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  arrange(k, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta)

pred_list <- list()

for (m in names(model_list)) {
  fit_glm <- model_list[[m]]
  
  newdat <- scenario_features %>%
    mutate(
      k = factor(k, levels = levels(model.frame(fit_glm)$k)),
      signal_mode = factor(signal_mode, levels = levels(model.frame(fit_glm)$signal_mode))
    )
  
  pred_prob <- predict(fit_glm, newdata = newdat, type = "response")
  
  pred_list[[m]] <- scenario_features %>%
    mutate(
      method = m,
      pred_win_prob = pred_prob
    )
}

pred_long <- bind_rows(pred_list)

pred_winner_table <- pred_long %>%
  group_by(k, signal_cluster, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  mutate(max_prob = max(pred_win_prob, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  filter(pred_win_prob == max_prob) %>%
  summarise(
    model_predicted_winner = paste(sort(unique(method)), collapse = "; "),
    max_pred_win_prob = max(pred_win_prob, na.rm = TRUE),
    cluster_n_otus_template = first(cluster_n_otus_template),
    cluster_avg_silhouette = first(cluster_avg_silhouette),
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance = first(cluster_mean_relative_abundance),
    cluster_mean_prevalence = first(cluster_mean_prevalence),
    within_cop_mean = first(within_cop_mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(k, cluster_ordered, signal_mode, beta)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("MODEL-PREDICTED WINNER TABLE\n")
cat("This answers: according to the fitted models, which method should win in each situation?\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

pred_winner_print <- pred_winner_table %>%
  mutate(
    max_pred_win_prob = round(max_pred_win_prob, 4),
    cluster_avg_silhouette = round(cluster_avg_silhouette, 4),
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance = signif(cluster_mean_relative_abundance, 4),
    cluster_mean_prevalence = round(cluster_mean_prevalence, 4),
    within_cop_mean = round(within_cop_mean, 4)
  )

print(as.data.frame(pred_winner_print), row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- "what to say" summary for each method --------------------
## Summarize the situations where each method is the model-predicted winner

method_region_summary <- pred_winner_table %>%
  separate_rows(model_predicted_winner, sep = "; ") %>%
  group_by(model_predicted_winner) %>%
  summarise(
    n_situations_won = n(),
    k_values = paste(sort(unique(k)), collapse = ", "),
    signal_modes = paste(sort(unique(signal_mode)), collapse = ", "),
    beta_min = min(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta_q1 = as.numeric(quantile(beta, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    beta_median = median(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    beta_q3 = as.numeric(quantile(beta, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    beta_max = max(beta, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_n_otu = mean(cluster_n_otus_template, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_silhouette = mean(cluster_avg_silhouette, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_mean_rel_abund = mean(cluster_mean_relative_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_mean_prevalence = mean(cluster_mean_prevalence, na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_within_cop_mean = mean(within_cop_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_situations_won), model_predicted_winner)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("COMPACT 'WHAT TO SAY' SUMMARY FOR EACH METHOD\n")
cat("Interpretation:\n")
cat("- k_values: which k values this method tends to win under\n")
cat("- signal_modes: which signal types this method tends to win under\n")
cat("- beta range / quartiles: what effect-size range favors this method\n")
cat("- avg cluster features: what kind of signal cluster favors this method\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

method_region_print <- method_region_summary %>%
  mutate(
    avg_n_otu = round(avg_n_otu, 2),
    avg_silhouette = round(avg_silhouette, 4),
    avg_mean_rel_abund = signif(avg_mean_rel_abund, 4),
    avg_mean_prevalence = round(avg_mean_prevalence, 4),
    avg_within_cop_mean = round(avg_within_cop_mean, 4),
    beta_min = round(beta_min, 4),
    beta_q1 = round(beta_q1, 4),
    beta_median = round(beta_median, 4),
    beta_q3 = round(beta_q3, 4),
    beta_max = round(beta_max, 4)
  )

print(as.data.frame(method_region_print), row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- optional: top situations per method --------------------
## Shows the observed situations where the model gives the highest probability of winning

top_situations_per_method <- pred_long %>%
```

# power
```{r}
## =========================================================
## GLMM for WINNING
## outcome: whether a method wins in that replicate-situation
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(lme4)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## -------------------- long format --------------------
dat_long <- results %>%
  select(
    rep_id, k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta,
    cluster_n_otus_template,
    cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance,
    cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean,
    all_of(grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level),
    k = factor(k),
    signal_cluster = factor(signal_cluster),
    signal_mode = factor(signal_mode)
  ) %>%
  filter(beta > 0)

## -------------------- define winner within each replicate-situation --------------------
## 这里先用最简单定义：reject 最大，也就是 reject=1 的算 winner；
## 如果多个 method 都 reject=1，则都记为 winner
## 如果一个都不显著，则 winner 为空（这一组删掉）
dat_win <- dat_long %>%
  group_by(rep_id, k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta) %>%
  mutate(max_reject = max(reject, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(max_reject > 0) %>%
  mutate(win = as.integer(reject == max_reject))

## -------------------- standardize cluster covariates --------------------
scale2 <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))

dat_win <- dat_win %>%
  mutate(
    z_beta = scale2(beta),
    z_n_otu = scale2(cluster_n_otus_template),
    z_silhouette = scale2(cluster_avg_silhouette),
    z_mean_rel_abund = scale2(cluster_mean_relative_abundance),
    z_mean_prev = scale2(cluster_mean_prevalence),
    z_within_cop = scale2(within_cop_mean)
  )

methods_to_fit <- sort(unique(dat_win$method))

win_fit_list <- list()
win_coef_list <- list()

for (m in methods_to_fit) {
  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat("Fitting WIN model for:", m, "\n")
  cat("=============================\n")
  
  dat_m <- dat_win %>%
    mutate(win_m = as.integer(method == m & win == 1))
  
  if (length(unique(dat_m$win_m)) < 2) {
    cat("Skip", m, ": win outcome has no variation.\n")
    next
  }
  
  fit_m <- glmer(
    win_m ~ signal_mode * z_beta +
      z_n_otu +
      z_silhouette +
      z_mean_rel_abund +
      z_mean_prev +
      z_within_cop +
      (1 | k/signal_cluster),
    data = dat_m,
    family = binomial(),
    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )
  
  win_fit_list[[m]] <- fit_m
  
  sm <- coef(summary(fit_m))
  coef_tab <- data.frame(
    method = m,
    term = rownames(sm),
    estimate = sm[, "Estimate"],
    std_error = sm[, "Std. Error"],

    p_value = sm[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    odds_ratio = exp(sm[, "Estimate"]),
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  win_coef_list[[m]] <- coef_tab
  
  cat("\nWIN model coefficients:\n")
  print(coef_tab, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("\nTop cluster-feature coefficients by |estimate|:\n")
  print(
    coef_tab %>%
      filter(term %in% c(
        "z_n_otu",
        "z_silhouette",
        "z_mean_rel_abund",
        "z_mean_prev",
        "z_within_cop"
      )) %>%
      mutate(abs_estimate = abs(estimate)) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_estimate)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

win_coef_all <- bind_rows(win_coef_list)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("ALL WIN-MODEL COEFFICIENTS\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(win_coef_all, row.names = FALSE)
```
