# Type 1

```{r}
## =========================================================
## GLMM for TYPE I ERROR
## outcome: whether a method falsely rejects under null
## only use beta == 0
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(lme4)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## -------------------- check --------------------
if (!exists("results")) stop("Object 'results' not found.")
if (!is.data.frame(results)) stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "rep_id", "k", "signal_cluster", "signal_mode", "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_avg_silhouette",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance",
  "cluster_mean_prevalence",
  "within_cop_mean"
)

miss <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(miss) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) stop("No p-value columns found.")

## -------------------- long format, null only --------------------
dat_null <- results %>%
  select(
    rep_id, k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta,
    cluster_n_otus_template,
    cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance,
    cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean,
    all_of(p_cols)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("p_"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    fp = as.integer(pval < alpha_level),
    k = factor(k),
    signal_cluster = factor(signal_cluster),
    signal_mode = factor(signal_mode)
  ) %>%
  filter(beta == 0)

## -------------------- standardize cluster covariates --------------------
scale2 <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))

dat_null <- dat_null %>%
  mutate(
    z_n_otu = scale2(cluster_n_otus_template),
    z_silhouette = scale2(cluster_avg_silhouette),
    z_mean_rel_abund = scale2(cluster_mean_relative_abundance),
    z_mean_prev = scale2(cluster_mean_prevalence),
    z_within_cop = scale2(within_cop_mean)
  )

methods_to_fit <- sort(unique(dat_null$method))

type1_fit_list <- list()
type1_coef_list <- list()

for (m in methods_to_fit) {
  cat("\n=============================\n")
  cat("Fitting TYPE I ERROR model for:", m, "\n")
  cat("=============================\n")
  
  dat_m <- dat_null %>% filter(method == m)
  
  if (length(unique(dat_m$fp)) < 2) {
    cat("Skip", m, ": fp outcome has no variation.\n")
    next
  }
  
  fit_m <- glmer(
    fp ~ signal_mode +
      z_n_otu +
      z_silhouette +
      z_mean_rel_abund +
      z_mean_prev +
      z_within_cop +
      (1 | k/signal_cluster),
    data = dat_m,
    family = binomial(),
    control = glmerControl(
      optimizer = "bobyqa",
      optCtrl = list(maxfun = 2e5)
    )
  )
  
  type1_fit_list[[m]] <- fit_m
  
  sm <- coef(summary(fit_m))
  coef_tab <- data.frame(
    method = m,
    term = rownames(sm),
    estimate = sm[, "Estimate"],
    std_error = sm[, "Std. Error"],
    z_value = sm[, "z value"],
    p_value = sm[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
    odds_ratio = exp(sm[, "Estimate"]),
    row.names = NULL,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  type1_coef_list[[m]] <- coef_tab
  
  cat("\nTYPE I ERROR model coefficients:\n")
  print(coef_tab, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("\nTop cluster-feature coefficients by |estimate|:\n")
  print(
    coef_tab %>%
      filter(term %in% c(
        "z_n_otu",
        "z_silhouette",
        "z_mean_rel_abund",
        "z_mean_prev",
        "z_within_cop"
      )) %>%
      mutate(
        abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
        direction = ifelse(estimate > 0, "increase FP", "decrease FP")
      ) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs_estimate)),
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

type1_coef_all <- bind_rows(type1_coef_list)

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("ALL TYPE I ERROR MODEL COEFFICIENTS\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(type1_coef_all, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- summarize which cluster features matter most --------------------
type1_feature_rank <- type1_coef_all %>%
  filter(term %in% c(
    "z_n_otu",
    "z_silhouette",
    "z_mean_rel_abund",
    "z_mean_prev",
    "z_within_cop"
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    abs_estimate = abs(estimate),
    direction = ifelse(estimate > 0, "increase FP", "decrease FP")
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, desc(abs_estimate))

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("WHICH CLUSTER FEATURES ARE MOST ASSOCIATED WITH TYPE I ERROR?\n")
cat("Because covariates are standardized, |estimate| is comparable.\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(type1_feature_rank, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- summarize our methods only --------------------
our_methods <- intersect(
  c("GLaD_0.5_weighted", "GLaD_0.5_unweighted",
    "GLaD_1_weighted", "GLaD_1_unweighted"),
  unique(type1_feature_rank$method)
)

our_type1_summary <- type1_feature_rank %>%
  filter(method %in% our_methods) %>%
  group_by(method) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = abs_estimate, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\n\n============================================================\n")
cat("TOP 3 CLUSTER FEATURES FOR TYPE I ERROR OF OUR METHODS\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(our_type1_summary, row.names = FALSE)
```

# joint power

```{r}
## =========================================================
## JOINT GLMM FOR POWER
## Better model for comparing methods directly
##
## outcome: reject = I(p < 0.05)
## data: beta > 0 only
##
## key idea:
##   one joint model with method + method x covariate interactions
## so we can compare methods directly
## =========================================================

options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, width = 1000)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(lme4)
})

alpha_level <- 0.05

## -------------------- checks --------------------
if (!exists("results")) stop("Object 'results' not found.")
if (!is.data.frame(results)) stop("'results' must be a data.frame.")

bad_cols <- intersect(c("X", "...1", "row.names"), names(results))
if (length(bad_cols) > 0) {
  results <- results[, setdiff(names(results), bad_cols), drop = FALSE]
}

needed_cols <- c(
  "rep_id", "k", "signal_cluster", "signal_mode", "beta",
  "cluster_n_otus_template",
  "cluster_avg_silhouette",
  "cluster_mean_relative_abundance",
  "cluster_mean_prevalence",
  "within_cop_mean"
)

miss <- setdiff(needed_cols, names(results))
if (length(miss) > 0) {
  stop("Missing columns: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
}

p_cols <- grep("^p_", names(results), value = TRUE)
if (length(p_cols) == 0) stop("No p-value columns found.")

## -------------------- long format --------------------
dat_power <- results %>%
  select(
    rep_id, k, signal_cluster, signal_mode, beta,
    cluster_n_otus_template,
    cluster_avg_silhouette,
    cluster_mean_relative_abundance,
    cluster_mean_prevalence,
    within_cop_mean,
    all_of(p_cols)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(p_cols),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "pval"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    method = sub("^p_", "", method),
    reject = as.integer(pval < alpha_level),
    k = factor(k),
    signal_cluster = factor(signal_cluster),
    signal_mode = factor(signal_mode),
    method = factor(method)
  ) %>%
  filter(beta > 0)

## -------------------- choose method reference level --------------------
## You can change this if you want a different baseline method
preferred_order <- c(
  "GLaD_0.5_unweighted",
  "GLaD_0.5_weighted",
  "GLaD_1_unweighted",
  "GLaD_1_weighted",
  "GUniFrac",
  "unifrac_unweighted",
  "unifrac_weighted_phyloseq",
  "aitchison",
  "bray",
  "euclidean",
  "jaccard"
)

method_levels <- unique(dat_power$method)
preferred_order <- preferred_order[preferred_order %in% method_levels]
other_methods <- setdiff(sort(method_levels), preferred_order)
dat_power$method <- factor(dat_power$method, levels = c(preferred_order, other_methods))

## -------------------- standardize continuous covariates --------------------
scale2 <- function(x) as.numeric(scale(x))

dat_power <- dat_power %>%
  mutate(
    z_beta = scale2(beta),
    z_n_otu = scale2(cluster_n_otus_template),
    z_silhouette = scale2(cluster_avg_silhouette),
    z_mean_rel_abund = scale2(cluster_mean_relative_abundance),
    z_mean_prev = scale2(cluster_mean_prevalence),
    z_within_cop = scale2(within_cop_mean)
  )

## -------------------- fit joint GLMM --------------------
## main effects:
##   method + signal_mode + z_beta + cluster features
##
## interactions:
##   method x cluster features
##   method x z_beta
##   signal_mode x z_beta
##
## This lets you compare methods directly.

fit_power_joint <- glmer(
  reject ~
    method +
    signal_mode +
    z_beta +
    z_n_otu +
    z_silhouette +
    z_mean_rel_abund +
    z_mean_prev +
    z_within_cop +
    signal_mode:z_beta +
    method:z_beta +
    method:z_n_otu +
    method:z_silhouette +
    method:z_mean_rel_abund +
    method:z_mean_prev +
    method:z_within_cop +
    (1 | k/signal_cluster),
  data = dat_power,
  family = binomial(),
  control = glmerControl(
    optimizer = "bobyqa",
    optCtrl = list(maxfun = 3e5)
  )
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL SUMMARY\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(summary(fit_power_joint))

## -------------------- coefficient table --------------------
sm_power <- coef(summary(fit_power_joint))

power_coef_table <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(sm_power),
  estimate = sm_power[, "Estimate"],
  std_error = sm_power[, "Std. Error"],
  z_value = sm_power[, "z value"],
  p_value = sm_power[, "Pr(>|z|)"],
  odds_ratio = exp(sm_power[, "Estimate"]),
  row.names = NULL,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL COEFFICIENT TABLE\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(power_coef_table, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- extract direct method-comparison interaction terms --------------------
## these are the key terms if you want to compare methods directly
feature_terms <- c(
  "z_n_otu",
  "z_silhouette",
  "z_mean_rel_abund",
  "z_mean_prev",
  "z_within_cop"
)

interaction_pattern <- paste0("method.*:(", paste(feature_terms, collapse = "|"), ")$")

power_method_feature_interactions <- power_coef_table %>%
  filter(grepl(interaction_pattern, term)) %>%
  mutate(abs_estimate = abs(estimate)) %>%
  arrange(p_value, desc(abs_estimate))

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: METHOD x FEATURE INTERACTIONS\n")
cat("These terms directly tell you whether a method differs from the reference method\n")
cat("in its dependence on a given cluster feature.\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(power_method_feature_interactions, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- simple per-method effective slopes --------------------
## This reconstructs each method's slope for each cluster feature:
##   slope(reference method) = main feature coefficient
##   slope(other method) = main feature coefficient + interaction coefficient
##
## Very useful for making tables.

all_methods <- levels(dat_power$method)
ref_method <- all_methods[1]

get_effective_slope_table <- function(coef_tab, methods, feature_terms, ref_method) {
  out <- list()
  
  for (feat in feature_terms) {
    main_est <- coef_tab$estimate[match(feat, coef_tab$term)]
    if (length(main_est) == 0 || is.na(main_est)) main_est <- 0
    
    for (m in methods) {
      if (m == ref_method) {
        est <- main_est
      } else {
        int_term <- paste0("method", m, ":", feat)
        int_est <- coef_tab$estimate[match(int_term, coef_tab$term)]
        if (length(int_est) == 0 || is.na(int_est)) int_est <- 0
        est <- main_est + int_est
      }
      
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        method = m,
        feature = feat,
        log_odds_slope = est,
        odds_ratio = exp(est),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

power_effective_slopes <- get_effective_slope_table(
  coef_tab = power_coef_table,
  methods = all_methods,
  feature_terms = feature_terms,
  ref_method = ref_method
) %>%
  arrange(method, feature)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: EFFECTIVE PER-METHOD FEATURE SLOPES\n")
cat("These are the implied odds ratios for each method and each feature.\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(power_effective_slopes, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- top features per method --------------------
power_feature_rank <- power_effective_slopes %>%
  mutate(
    abs_log_odds_slope = abs(log_odds_slope),
    direction = ifelse(log_odds_slope > 0, "increase power", "decrease power")
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, desc(abs_log_odds_slope))

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: FEATURE IMPORTANCE BY METHOD\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(power_feature_rank, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## CONTRAST TESTS FOR JOINT POWER MODEL
## Compare method-specific slopes for the 4 cluster features
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(emmeans)
})

## 这 4 个就是你表里的变量
feature_vars <- c(
  "z_within_cop",
  "z_mean_rel_abund",
  "z_mean_prev",
  "z_n_otu"
)

## 一个函数：对某个 covariate 做 method slope comparison
get_method_slope_contrasts <- function(fit, var_name, adjust_method = "tukey") {
  
  ## emtrends 提取每个 method 对该变量的 slope
  tr <- emtrends(
    fit,
    specs = "method",
    var = var_name
  )
  
  ## method 两两比较
  pw <- pairs(tr, adjust = adjust_method)
  
  ## 输出为 data.frame
  tr_df <- as.data.frame(summary(tr))
  pw_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pw))
  
  tr_df$feature <- var_name
  pw_df$feature <- var_name
  
  list(
    trends = tr_df,
    contrasts = pw_df
  )
}

power_contrast_results <- lapply(feature_vars, function(v) {
  get_method_slope_contrasts(fit_power_joint, v, adjust_method = "tukey")
})
names(power_contrast_results) <- feature_vars

## -------------------- print estimated slopes --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: ESTIMATED METHOD-SPECIFIC SLOPES\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

power_slopes_all <- bind_rows(lapply(power_contrast_results, `[[`, "trends")) %>%
  arrange(feature, method)

print(power_slopes_all, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- print pairwise slope contrasts --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: PAIRWISE CONTRAST TESTS OF METHOD SLOPES\n")
cat("Null: two methods have the same slope for a given feature\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

power_pairwise_all <- bind_rows(lapply(power_contrast_results, `[[`, "contrasts")) %>%
  arrange(feature, contrast)

print(power_pairwise_all, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- if you only want significant contrasts --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT POWER MODEL: SIGNIFICANT METHOD CONTRASTS (p < 0.05)\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

power_pairwise_sig <- power_pairwise_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(feature, p.value)

print(power_pairwise_sig, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
type1_effective_slopes <- get_effective_slope_table(
  coef_tab = type1_coef_table,
  methods = all_methods,
  feature_terms = feature_terms,
  ref_method = ref_method
) %>%
  arrange(method, feature)

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL: EFFECTIVE PER-METHOD FEATURE SLOPES\n")
cat("These are the implied odds ratios for each method and each feature.\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(type1_effective_slopes, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- top features per method --------------------
type1_feature_rank <- type1_effective_slopes %>%
  mutate(
    abs_log_odds_slope = abs(log_odds_slope),
    direction = ifelse(log_odds_slope > 0, "increase type I error", "decrease type I error")
  ) %>%
  arrange(method, desc(abs_log_odds_slope))

cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL: FEATURE IMPORTANCE BY METHOD\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")
print(type1_feature_rank, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
## =========================================================
## CONTRAST TESTS FOR JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL
## Compare method-specific slopes for the 4 cluster features
## =========================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(emmeans)
})

feature_vars <- c(
  "z_within_cop",
  "z_mean_rel_abund",
  "z_mean_prev",
  "z_n_otu"
)

get_method_slope_contrasts <- function(fit, var_name, adjust_method = "tukey") {
  
  tr <- emtrends(
    fit,
    specs = "method",
    var = var_name
  )
  
  pw <- pairs(tr, adjust = adjust_method)
  
  tr_df <- as.data.frame(summary(tr))
  pw_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pw))
  
  tr_df$feature <- var_name
  pw_df$feature <- var_name
  
  list(
    trends = tr_df,
    contrasts = pw_df
  )
}

type1_contrast_results <- lapply(feature_vars, function(v) {
  get_method_slope_contrasts(fit_type1_joint, v, adjust_method = "tukey")
})
names(type1_contrast_results) <- feature_vars

## -------------------- print estimated slopes --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL: ESTIMATED METHOD-SPECIFIC SLOPES\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

type1_slopes_all <- bind_rows(lapply(type1_contrast_results, `[[`, "trends")) %>%
  arrange(feature, method)

print(type1_slopes_all, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- print pairwise slope contrasts --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL: PAIRWISE CONTRAST TESTS OF METHOD SLOPES\n")
cat("Null: two methods have the same slope for a given feature\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

type1_pairwise_all <- bind_rows(lapply(type1_contrast_results, `[[`, "contrasts")) %>%
  arrange(feature, contrast)

print(type1_pairwise_all, row.names = FALSE)

## -------------------- if you only want significant contrasts --------------------
cat("\n============================================================\n")
cat("JOINT TYPE I ERROR MODEL: SIGNIFICANT METHOD CONTRASTS (p < 0.05)\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

type1_pairwise_sig <- type1_pairwise_all %>%
  filter(p.value < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(feature, p.value)

print(type1_pairwise_sig, row.names = FALSE)
```
